Container.Name: mtg-arbitrage
Container.Overview: Finds Magic: The Gathering cards that are cheap on Cardmarket (EU) and sell for more in the US (TCGplayer, Mana Pool, Card Kingdom and CardConduit buylists). Prices refresh daily. Personal use: keep it behind the password.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Login password (any username). Required if the app is reachable from outside your network.

Config.Name: Daily refresh hour (UTC)
Config.Description: UTC hour when prices are re-downloaded every day; -1 disables

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the appdata files (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the appdata files (100 = users)

Config.Name: Price cache
Config.Description: Downloaded price data (~350 MB, re-downloaded daily)
